FEC set resolver APIs for adding shreds, querying, and forcing completion.

# Purpose
`fd_fec_resolver.h` declares the interface for an FEC set resolver used by the shred tile to collect, validate, and complete shred groups. It defines the resolver object, memory size and alignment rules, and the functions used to create, join, configure, and delete the resolver. The file also declares the main operations for adding shreds, querying shreds, checking completed FEC sets, and forcing completion when coding shreds are not available. The interface includes return codes and a spill record type so callers can track rejected, ignored, completed, and evicted FEC set state.
